free_text: The 81-year-old male has a high PSA of 12.87 ng/mL and a prior biopsy-proven prostate adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+3 (ISUP grade group 3). MRI shows a PI-RADS 5 lesion, clinically T2a, with restricted diffusion, suggesting high-risk local disease. The management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and preferences, balancing the aggressive local tumor characteristics against the patient's age and overall health status.
